newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Joyce opens 2nd Armani boutique in HK.
newsitem.headline: Joyce opens 2nd Armani boutique in HK.

text.p: Upmarket clothing retailer Joyce Boutique Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had opened Hong Kong's second Giorgio Armani boutique.
The new 7,600 sq ft boutique, located in the Regent Hotel shopping arcade in Tsim Sha Tsui is larger than the company's first Armani boutique in Alexandra House in Central.
Joyce Boutique reported net profit of HK$81.1 million for the year ended March 31, 1996, an increase of 7.8 percent over the previous year, while earnings per share rose one percent to 29.2 cents.
